review: Complete subprocess boundary and tests reviewed. Original worker reuse, charged startup/failure cleanup, bounded progress count, timeout kill/restart and unreaped-worker refusal retained. No active callers existed in current qa/scripts/qualification Python sources.

reproducer.scope: trusted local pickleable handler result with slow parent deserialization

correction: Custom pickleable results could execute slow reconstruction in the parent after poll succeeded. IPC now permits only bounded builtin literal data and uses callback-free same-interpreter marshal framing; 1 MiB wire, 4096 values, depth32, finite floats and 256-bit ints. Custom objects/oversize/cyclic data are rejected. Bounded transport and cleanup are charged; OS scheduling and arbitrary grandchildren are not claimed as supervised. Null payload is now literal data, not an undocumented shutdown sentinel.
compatibility: Factory remains pickleable/importable under spawn. Payload/progress/results no longer accept arbitrary custom objects; callers must export bounded builtin data. This is a future utility with no production caller in the checked tree.
